notes: Qt 6.4.2; scene graph backend=default/RHI (graphicsApi enum 1); platform=xcb. frame_ms = interval between consecutive QQuickWindow::frameSwapped emissions (software: after QSGSoftwareRenderLoop rendered the dirty regions and flushed the QBackingStore to X (xcb/SHM); RHI/GL: after swapBuffers returned on the render thread); QT_QPA_UPDATE_IDLE_TIME=0 (Qt default 5 ms pacing of update requests removed unless --paced); redraw requested continuously (window->update() from a queued tick after every frameSwapped; no vsync/timer pacing). First 2 s warm-up discarded (scripts restart at t=0). List = QML ListView (reuseItems, cacheBuffer 600) over C++ QAbstractListModel (rows computed in data()); delegate height = row height role; ListView estimates contentHeight for variable heights so scripted offsets are in exact sum-of-heights space but contentY is clamped to the ListView estimate. rows_drawn = number of data(TitleRole) calls (delegate creations + reuse rebinds). Producer = std::thread (xorshift32), batches posted with QMetaObject::invokeMethod(Qt::QueuedConnection); bounded in-flight counter 100k (drop+count in producer); UI applies the whole batch once per frame with one dataChanged per update. Canvas impl=painted (QQuickPaintedItem, QPainter into QImage target); gradient fill via per-shape QLinearGradient(ObjectBoundingMode) brushes, antialiased rounded clip path; drop shadows = pre-blurred (box x3, 8px) sprite per (type,size), drawn for 1 shape in 10 (QPainter has no blur primitive). Graph: 10000-pt drawPolyline per frame.
